verdict.rationale: Ironclad exposes a REST API with OAuth bearer tokens, webhooks, and endpoints to launch workflows, trigger exports, and manage records — all of which can be scripted/automated without the UI, supporting headless-style automation. However there is no CLI, no explicit CI/CD integration examples, and workflow launch still requires a pre-published design from the in-app Workflow Designer, limiting full headless autonomy. Missing for 10: dedicated CLI or SDK for CI pipelines, explicit CI/CD examples, and evidence that workflow publishing itself can be done headlessly.
